session_dialogue.text: Hello. How are you feeling today?
I'm tired, but I'm trying to stay clean. It's hard, but I'm here.
That's brave of you to be here. It sounds like you're working really hard to take care of yourself.
Thanks, but I don't know if I'm doing it right. Sometimes I feel like I'm just making things worse.
It’s completely normal to feel uncertain. You’re not alone in this, and it’s okay to feel like you’re not sure what’s working.
Yeah, I guess. It's just... everything feels so heavy. Like I can't breathe sometimes.
That sounds really overwhelming. It’s okay to feel that way—your feelings are valid, and you don’t have to carry them alone.
I know, but I keep thinking about the last time I messed up. It felt like the world was crashing down.
It’s understandable to feel that way when things get tough. You’re not alone in feeling like the world might fall apart when things don’t go as planned.
Yeah, I guess I just feel like I’m not strong enough to keep going. Like I’m not even trying hard enough.
You’re not failing, and you’re not weak. You’re showing up, even when it’s hard—which is already a sign of strength.
Thanks, but I still feel like I’m not enough. Like no matter what I do, it’s never enough.
That feeling of not being enough can be really heavy. It’s okay to feel that way, but it doesn’t mean you’re not enough—it just means you’re human.
I know, but it's like I can't shake it. Every little thing feels like a failure.
It’s hard to feel like every moment is a failure, but I want you to know that your worth isn’t tied to your mistakes or your progress. You’re doing the best you can, and that matters.
Yeah, but I keep thinking about the last time I messed up. It felt like the world was crashing down.

You’re not alone in feeling that way, and it’s okay to feel overwhelmed. But I want you to know that you’re not the only one who has felt like the world might fall apart when things don’t go as planned.
I just feel like I’m stuck in this loop. No matter how hard I try, I can’t seem to break free.

It sounds like you’re trapped in a cycle that feels impossible to escape. But I want you to know that you’re not stuck forever—there are ways to begin to shift that pattern, even if it feels small right now.
Yeah, but every time I try, I just end up falling back into the same old habits. It’s like I can’t even control myself.
